summary: Project to build and deploy an application with an advanced admin panel and a dedicated anti-DDoS/security system branded as "TREY C SECURITY".
architectural_notes: Security system component should be branded/named "TREY C SECURITY".

existing_features.title: Upgrade the frontend admin experience into a more advanced panel by adding a dedicated "TREY C SECURITY" section within the existing AdminPanelPage, showing security metrics, recent security events, and controls to manage protections (toggle, thresholds, blocklist/allowlist management).

Make the admin panel "more advanced" by adding high-value admin tools beyond the current order list: bulk order actions (approve/ship/delete), data export (CSV download) for orders, and an admin audit log view for critical admin actions (e.g., resets, deletes, security config changes).

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement a super advanced anti-DDoS/security system branded as "TREY C SECURITY".
Make the admin panel more advanced by adding comprehensive improvements and features deemed necessary.

Implement a backend anti-abuse/anti-DDoS protection layer branded as "TREY C SECURITY" that rate-limits and blocks abusive callers in a way compatible with Internet Computer constraints (no IP address access), applying protections to all update calls that mutate state (e.g., createOrder, updateOrderStatus, setTrackingNumber, deleteOrder, resetAllData, saveCallerUserProfile).

Add backend TREY C SECURITY observability endpoints for administrators to view security posture: aggregated counters (allowed/denied/throttled), recent security events, and current configuration (rate-limit parameters, blocklist/allowlist sizes), all admin-gated.

Add backend TREY C SECURITY administrative controls for tuning and response: enable/disable protections, update rate-limit thresholds, clear/reset security counters, and add/remove principals from blocklist/allowlist, all admin-gated and auditable.

projectName: Add TREY C SECURITY anti-abuse protections and expand the admin panel with security + management tools
